```{python}
import pandas as pd

attractions = pd.read_csv("data/attractions.csv")
top = attractions.loc[attractions["visits_2025"].idxmax()]
top_name = top["attraction"]
top_visits = f"{top['visits_2025']:,}"
total_visits = f"{attractions['visits_2025'].sum():,}"
n_free = int(attractions["admission"].str.startswith("Free").sum())
```

Dear partners, in 2025 London's ten most visited ALVA member attractions welcomed
`{python} total_visits` visits, led by the `{python} top_name` with
`{python} top_visits`, and `{python} n_free` of those ten are free to enter.
Our new visitor guide helps your guests make the most of a day in the city: the
five sights to start with, how to get around, a tip from a local and a table of the
nearest tube stations. It is available as a web page, a Word document, a PDF and
a slide deck, so you can share whichever suits your guests best.

London Tourism Office

*Visit numbers: [ALVA, visits made in 2025](https://www.alva.org.uk/details.cfm?p=423),
retrieved 2026-10-30.*
